text:
emma: hi team, first day and hitting a couple of odd onboarding things. SMS MFA code never arrives (APAC number). also the GitHub invite went to my alias (emma.personal@...) not my work email, and the yubikey enrollment page errors out with 'token invalid'. who should i poke?
it-support: welcome @emma! for SMS, are you using the +61 number you provided on the offer? sometimes SMS gateways block virtual numbers.
emma: yep +61, it's my local number. i did get other sms this morning. no SMS from Okta.
jamie: if it's regional carrier filtering the gateway, we fall back to Push or Passcode in Okta. try opening Okta Verify -> Account -> Show passcodes and use one of those to sign in.
emma: opened Okta Verify but no account shows in the app. when i try to re-register it fails at the QR step with 'Enrollment failed: region mismatch'.
security-bot: flagged: possible geo-block on MFA registration. Ticket #ONB-4021 created.
it-support: can you try mounting a VPN to a US region (or use the company VPN client) and see if the registration flow completes? sometimes our MFA provider expects a trusted region for initial enroll.
emma: tried company VPN and got further. Okta now shows my factor but the SMS fallback still blank.
people-ops: re: GitHub invite, contractors get invites to the alias by default. i've swapped your account type to full-time and resent the invite to emma@redwood.ai. check spam?
emma: found the GH invite in spam, accepted. thanks.
jamie: yubikey: which page errors? the yubikey enrollment from 1Password or from our SSO device-trust flow?
emma: the yubikey registration on the account settings page returns 'token invalid' after I touch the key. i can register the key in the browser on another site though.
it-support: that usually implies the attestation token from the browser wasn't sent correctly; can you try a different browser (Chrome vs Safari) and make sure no extensions are blocking WebAuthn? also ensure the key firmware is up to date.
emma: switched to Chrome, cleared extensions, still 'token invalid'. tried an incognito window and it worked! looks like an adblocker was interfering.
people-ops: 1Password seat: provisioning shows you in the queue. once Okta factors are settled, 1Password sync usually completes within 10 minutes.
emma: got 1Password invite shortly after. yubikey is registered. SMS still not coming though — but since I have Okta Verify passcodes and Yubi, I can sign in fine.
it-support: we'll keep the SMS ticket open to investigate gateway logs; ETA EOD. if you need SMS for any recovery flows we can add a backup number.
emma: thanks everyone! excited to be here. any onboarding tips?
jamie: check the eng handbook in the Welcome folder and drop into #eng-hello later for a quick intro. also ping me for pairing sessions.
people-ops: welcome @emma :tada: we'll send the onboarding checklist DM with next steps and paperwork.
emma: appreciate it 60a
